title: 1986 AMC 8 Problem 1
statement: In July \(1861,\) \(366\) inches of rain fell in Cherrapunji, India. What was the average rainfall in inches per hour during that month?

solutions.text:
The average rainfall per hour equals the total rainfall divided by the total number of hours. July has \(31\) days, or \(31 \times 24\) hours, so the average is \(\dfrac{366}{31 \times 24} = \dfrac{61}{124}\) inches per hour.

Thus, the correct answer is A .
hints: The average rate is the total rainfall divided by the total number of hours in the month
July has \(31\) days, and each day has \(24\) hours
